question.ask: How many furnishings are specified but not yet approved?
question.whyItMatters: The procurement coordinator cannot order until a client approves.

text.text: Your studio in one place. Move each Project through its phases, track every Furnishing from specified to installed, collect client Approvals before ordering, and keep Fee invoices flowing. Operational tracking only.
Each phase ends with a client approval. Do not skip the gate.
Concept: boards and a first floor plan.
Design development: specific pieces and finishes.
Add an Approval, send the presentation, and record the decision before moving the project on.
Add each piece with Add item and enter trade and client prices.
Confirm lead time with the vendor.
Collect the client deposit before ordering.
Mark the piece Ordered and set Expected delivery.
Items past their delivery date appear under Overdue.
Concept and design development fees at each approval.
Procurement deposit before the first order.
Final installation fee at the walk-through.
Create invoices from the project with Add fee invoice.
Follow up the day after the due date.
Check every piece against the specification
Send the final invoice and request a review
